title: ZombifiedPiglinXp
description: Restores XP drops from Zombified Piglins — even when they're not killed by a player.
body:
In Minecraft versions after 1.21.4, Zombified Piglins no longer drop XP unless killed directly by a player. This breaks gold farms that use automated killing methods like lava, water, or fall damage — farms that worked perfectly in 1.21.4 and earlier.

This mod restores the original behavior: Zombified Piglins always drop XP on death, regardless of what kills them.

![Ilmango's Xp gold farm working !](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/169270a1282b97aa31f94e16eedbe2d608b0970b.png)

Gold farms that also serve as XP farms work again exactly as they did in 1.21.4 and before — including illmango's gold farm design. Whether your setup uses lava blades, fall damage, or any other automated system, Zombified Piglins will drop their 5 XP points on every kill — no player interaction required.

No configuration needed. Install and it works.

---

**Fabric API required**

This mod requires Fabric API. It must be installed alongside this mod. (only for 26.1.x)

| Minecraft | Fabric API |
|-----------|------------|
| 26.1.x | 0.149.1+26.1.2 |
